description.zh: 任务的描述信息。长度不超过100个字符。
description.en: The description of the task. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must pass this **ID** value. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If there is no **Instance Overview** page or **ID** value, you do not need to pass this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
下发给设备的任务执行规则文件。数据格式为JSON，长度不超过65536个字符。

更多信息，请参见下文“JobDocument定义”。
description.en:
The rule file for task execution sent to devices. The data format is JSON, and the length must not exceed 65 536 characters.

For more information, see "JobDocument definition" below.

description.zh:
自定义任务中下发给设备的文件。

仅**Type**为**CUSTOM_JOB**时，可传入此参数，且为非必传参数。

更多信息，请参见下文“JobFile定义”。
description.en:
The file sent to devices in a custom job.

This parameter can be passed only when **Type** is **CUSTOM_JOB**, and it is optional.

For more information, see "JobFile definition" below.

description.zh: 任务名称。支持中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_），长度范围为4~30个字符。
description.en: The job name. It can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 4 to 30 characters in length.

description.zh:
任务下作业推送速率配置，数据格式为JSON，长度不超过8192个字符。

更多信息，请参见下文“RolloutConfig定义”。
description.en:
The configuration for the push rate of jobs under the task, in JSON data format, with a maximum length of 8192 characters.

For more information, see "RolloutConfig definition" below.

description.zh:
任务调度时间的毫秒数。取值范围：当前时间的10分钟后到7天之间。

- 不传入此参数：任务创建后，立即初始化并调度执行。
- 传入此参数：任务创建后，先初始化，等到设置的调度时间后，才开始调度执行。
description.en:
The scheduled time for the task, in milliseconds. Valid values range from 10 minutes after the current time to 7 days ahead.

- If this parameter is not specified: The task is initialized and scheduled for execution immediately after creation.
- If this parameter is specified: The task is initialized after creation and scheduled for execution only at the specified time.

description.zh:
设备任务的目标设备配置。

更多信息，请参见下文“TargetConfig”。
description.en:
The target device configuration for the device job.

For more information, see "TargetConfig" below.

description.zh:
任务下作业执行的超时配置，数据格式为JSON，长度不超过8192个字符。

更多信息，请参见下文“TimeoutConfig定义”。
description.en:
The timeout configuration for job execution under the task, in JSON data format, with a maximum length of 8192 characters.

For more information, see "TimeoutConfig definition" below.

description.zh:
任务类型。取值：
- **INVOKE_SERVICE**：设备批量服务调用任务。
- **SET_PROPERTY**：设备批量属性设置任务。
- **PUB**：Pub批量消息推送任务。
- **CUSTOM_JOB**：自定义任务。
description.en:
The task type. Valid values:
- **INVOKE_SERVICE**: Batch service invocation task for devices.
- **SET_PROPERTY**: Batch property setting task for devices.
- **PUB**: Batch message push task using Pub.
- **CUSTOM_JOB**: Custom task.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

  > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 5.

  > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
